summary: Four of six capabilities are fully covered by mature open-source software plus two commodity sensor modules, all tried on the bench. C5 (12-month unattended) is nearly covered by ESPHome and needs configuration plus an enclosure and calibration routine - the Graveyard says this is where DIY builds die. C6 (monthly narrative report) has no candidate above 0.4. The consumer all-in-one fails the Bar on cost and privacy. Three graves: drift, cloud shutdowns, silent reconnect failures. Re-canvass 2026-10-23: seven candidates added across C2-C6 (AirGradient, Airthings, Grafana, cyd-scd41, Printables enclosures, Sensor.Community, SCD41 module). No new candidate beats the incumbent fit on any capability, so the verdicts stand; the G2 target of >=3 candidates per capability is now met.
